app.name: WiiJukebox
app.long_description: Native LAN client prototype. Discovers WiiJukebox servers, browses configured music sources and plays their persistent MP3 stream. Press 2 for the upstream WiiRadio projectM visualizer; B returns to browsing. Set up services in the server web UI first. Same LAN required; allow UDP 4001 and the server HTTP port. GPLv3. Music playback tested on Wii; projectM integration is experimental.
